title: The Tent Voice

cards.text: Don't unzip your tent for your sister's voice.
I'm camping alone, an hour's hike from my car.
At 2am, she called my name from right outside the zip.
She's home in the city, and she texted me goodnight at ten.
Then she whispered, "It's cold out here. Let me in."
A hand pressed into the tent wall, right where my face was.
I stayed silent until dawn, and the hand slowly slid away.
At sunrise, my phone buzzed with a text from her.
"Why were you outside my window all night?"

outro: Follow for a new story every night.
